text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, Yukino, weren't you 
having trouble in the washroom the other 
day?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Tracen Academy's full of pretty ladies, so 
I couldn't help thinkin'... is it really 
okay for someone like me to use the same 
vanity mirror?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about, looking all 
cute like that!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
The dorm belongs to everyone. Don't be 
shy, feel free to use it however you like!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but if there's anyone who won't budge, 
just let me know. I'll give 'em a strict 
talking-to!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, Hishiama-san, you're so warm. Just 
like a mom♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Well, whatever. If I get to be a mother 
figure to my cute junior, it's an honor.
